_comment: Answers for ops/fill_front_matter.py. A value fills every spelling of that placeholder across all seven files. __DROP_LINE__ deletes the line instead of filling it, for lines that should not exist on a digital edition. null means genuinely unknown and stays visibly bracketed, because a copyright page is legally material and a plausible wrong value is worse than an obvious blank.
_sources: Every filled value below is a fact this system already holds and publishes, not a decision made here. Author: the Stripe account representative, the git commit author, and the domain registrant. Imprint: the footer of all 159 site pages reads 'A Nova Consulting brand'. Address: the customer support address on the Stripe account, already printed on every receipt. Phil should correct any of these if they are wrong; nothing here was invented.
_dropped: An ISBN is a registered identifier issued by an agency; inventing one would collide with a real book and is not needed to sell a digital edition direct. A territory and printing statement describes a print run that does not exist. A designer and an illustrator credit would name people who did not do the work: the cover is generated by ops/build_cover.py and the illustrations are model generated. All four lines are removed rather than filled. They come back when there is a print edition and a real ISBN.
